readOnlyNavigationBootstrap.scope: Inspect every project-selected language service before activation, reuse the same in-memory config/RegisteredProject, and use prepared Python/TypeScript commands without managed installation. Read workspace YAML without migration or writes, including local-only overrides; constrain configuration links to the workspace. Each server gets a fresh external temporary SERENA_HOME and derived data folder, never imports project pickle caches or the old global registered-project list. Static language-service payload state is separate. Project activation/command/prompt/mode overrides are disabled only in this navigation instance; persistent user trust is unchanged. Explicit ask/deny/safety and actual definition identity remain authoritative.
readOnlyNavigationBootstrap.verification: runtime/tests/code-navigation.test.mjs and code_navigation_runtime_test.py cover actual policy, prepared services, configuration/activation boundaries, harmless pickle execution markers through fallback/native entries, linked YAML rejection and isolated native queries. Normal shutdown cleans temporary data; a forced Job/process exit may leave unused temporary directories which are never reused. Official TypeScript payload preparation and desktop acceptance are separate gates.

privateCodeNavigation.adapter: code-navigation-connection.mjs, code-navigation-job.mjs and the private branch of mcp-bridge.mjs
privateCodeNavigation.approved: 2026-11-27: reuse native MCP transport and scoped lifecycle behind the existing read-only code_navigation facade
privateCodeNavigation.scope: One lazy Windows x64 Serena connection per Agent/configuration/real workspace. Fixed overview/definition/references only; no projected raw tools, resources or instructions. Public MCP negotiation and policy stay unchanged. Private pinned Serena uses the SDK legacy negotiation option. No additional MCP client protocol or subprocess dependency.
privateCodeNavigation.lifecycle: Unique noninheritable KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE owner handle; Python joins before Serena configuration/import and closes its assignment handle. The SDK root is synchronously observed through its public PID using a SYNCHRONIZE-only handle. Cancellation, timeout or uncertain transport outcome retires that generation; no request replay. A subsequent explicit query may recreate only after verified closure. Failed cleanup releases handles while preserving an immutable unknown proof and blocking replacement.
privateCodeNavigation.verification: runtime/harness/test/code-navigation-connection.test.mjs exercises the actual MCP SDK/native Job with isolated fault servers, including pre-assignment cancellation, failed spawn, queued cancellation, descendant cleanup, driver gates/recovery and an immutable unknown-close fence. runtime/tests/code-navigation.test.mjs additionally verifies actual pinned Serena queries and warm file-edit visibility; this is not desktop E2E.

followUpSteering.approved: 2026-11-27: separate queue and steer; retain legacy queue behavior, running tools and native execution/history ownership
followUpSteering.scope: Independent model-request preemption after native input admission; preserve confirmed completed items, discard open blocks from canonical assistant history, stop undispatched proposals while draining started calls. job_output and registered foreground PowerShell jobs release only their registry wait, retaining the original producer. Optional promoted releaseReason=steer/preparing distinguishes a handoff from timeout or confirmed command start. Media status observers and optional completed-image inspection can yield without cancelling shared refresh/download or generation; job receipts and the original foreground budget remain authoritative. Desktop pre-dispatch tail/lease waits may withdraw only that proposal; real predecessors and dispatched actions still settle, with first window scope committed at the native metadata boundary. Direct synchronous MCP/Tasks are not generically backgrounded. Real cancellation and preparation settlement stay native. No node_modules writes or second Agent loop.
followUpSteering.delivery: The existing host ledger preserves stable message IDs, expected run identity, admitted versus consumed receipts, and uncertain recovery without automatic replay. Native claim-to-commit and third-party controller concurrency are not claimed as permanent exactly-once.
followUpSteering.removal: Replace with an equivalent upstream request-preemption and wait-yield contract; re-review all locked module hashes and cross-layer tests on upgrade. Consumers and loader must be migrated together.

streamingDecodeSpeed.scope: Request continuous_usage_stats on discovered vLLM chat streams with usage enabled. Publish request-scoped intermediate output counts through the existing transport observer for display. Other providers retain their wire options. End-of-request sessionStats remains upstream.
streamingDecodeSpeed.exitCondition: Prefer upstream per-request live decode samples when available. Checked by runtime/tests/composer-stats.test.mjs.

cacheUsagePresence.scope: Preserve explicitly reported zero cache reads through native mapUsage using the existing per-request provider-stream observer. Missing or null counters remain unknown; positive counts retain native mapping. Uses existing optional cacheReadTokens and native Session persistence; no inferred hits or aggregate server metrics.
cacheUsagePresence.exitCondition: Remove when the pinned upstream adapter preserves explicit zero versus absent cache receipts. Covered by runtime/tests/composer-stats.test.mjs.

toolErrorDiagnostics.scope: In-memory native tool error serialization only. Bounded safe transport cause codes and structured native cancellation kinds in optional error.info and readable error text; no arbitrary object fields, cause messages, addresses, stacks or credentials. Preserve native approval, cancellation, outcome and retry ownership.
toolErrorDiagnostics.exitCondition: Remove when an upgraded native serializer retains equivalent safe causes; source hash drift requires review.

requestFitRecovery.approved: 2026-10-28: locked SDK contract repair; no dependency upgrade, new host loop or Session v4 migration
requestFitRecovery.scope: Checked in-memory transforms at the native LLM, Pi adapter, basic compaction and retry module URLs. One normalized request projection supplies fit and dispatch. Local exhaustion rejects before HTTP; short length uses the original desired cap. Native compaction may recover once per turn only after a surface replacement and improved fit. Generic transport retry cannot replenish that allowance.
requestFitRecovery.storage: Existing failure code and requestId only. Request fit and remeasurement closures are transient, one-use, bounded and superseded by a new main request for the same session. Service usage and historical finish records are not rewritten.
requestFitRecovery.usageEvidence: The public Pi provider-stream callback observes explicit output counters for the three supported APIs. Missing counters remain unknown even when Pi normalizes them to zero. Length recovery and length-based overflow require the reported counter to match the normalized output; explicit provider errors retain their original classification.
requestFitRecovery.minimumOutput: Fit includes the protocol minimum. For Responses with max_output_tokens enabled, this is 16: an explicitly smaller desired cap fails INVALID_OUTPUT_BUDGET before HTTP, without compaction or transport retries; insufficient context allowance fails local budget recovery. Allowed dispatches never rely on Pi silently raising the wire cap. Existing explicit supportsMaxOutputTokens=false remains an opt-out of the wire cap.
requestFitRecovery.instructionRetention: The shared native range selector preserves the latest original source.kind=user event, even with generated role-user context after it. Within the existing retained-tail cutoff, it selects a larger priced balanced span on either side, preferring spans other than a lone checkpoint. Forced/manual compaction may still use a lone checkpoint when no other span is eligible; the existing pressure guard skips it. Long-turn tool history remains compactable. No user event is copied, reordered or synthesized; Session v4 and the native summary transaction remain unchanged. Later-span summaries may lose prefix-cache reuse. This protects the latest input verbatim, not arbitrary facts in every older summary.
requestFitRecovery.summaryPreparation: The final adapter fit must reserve the complete desired compaction output. COMPACTION_OUTPUT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED is a zero-HTTP preflight result carried by the existing transient sidecar. Native compaction geometrically shortens balanced ends within its original transaction and rebuilds input, prices and shadowed events together. Unsummarized tail nodes remain active. A bound registration/configuration continuation traverses the existing middleware and final projection and consumes the same prepared request for fit and dispatch. Preparation is finite but not exhaustive; only the final fitting candidate dispatches one summary HTTP. Actual length, cancellation or no fitting candidate commits no checkpoint. The existing pressure checkpoint guard also checks the final shortened input. No host loop or Session migration is introduced.
requestFitRecovery.deploymentCounting: Discovered vLLM chat routes share Pi's pinned wire serializer with a same-deployment /tokenize request. A validated count and deployment limit constrain the final wire cap. Estimated fallback remains available. Server-confirmed summary overflow also shortens at native balanced boundaries. Measured local exhaustion permits up to eight strictly improving regions within one recovery.
requestFitRecovery.removal: Replace with equivalent upstream prepared-request fit and bounded recovery contracts when available. Re-review all pinned modules/helpers on upgrade; fail startup on drift or late loading. Do not remove only the loader while retaining its consumers.

subagentReturnContract.scope: In-memory replacement of the child bootstrap and delegation-tool wording only. Native final delivery, optional send_message, lifecycle, permissions and persisted histories remain upstream-owned.
subagentReturnContract.removal: Remove on an upstream automatic-final-report contract; dependency upgrades must re-review these exact pinned sources.
